build.note: The evidenced build and the declared direction do not match, and that gap is the single most important thing in this tree. quests.name: Chapter One: one coach, one real fix, one pitch
quests.description: The action already agreed and not yet done. Pick one specific coach, audit their funnel for real, build the actual fix, and pitch with the work in hand. Sales sits at zero and it is the only node standing between an evidenced Builder and a validated AI Growth Operator. Nothing else in this tree unlocks what this unlocks.
quests.reward: First evidence on ent.sales; opens the path to Business Income and First Real Client
quests.proof: A named coach, a real audit, a delivered build, and a pitch actually sent.

quests.name: Ship one Zap that runs on live data
quests.description: Zapier is listed as a primary tool and holds 15 XP of exploration. That gap is the clearest knowledge-versus-experience mismatch in the tree. One working automation on real outreach data raises the ceiling on the whole Automation chain from 2 to 6.
quests.reward: +40–80 Automation XP; lifts auto.zapier's level cap from 2 to 6
quests.proof: A Zap that has run unattended on real records for a week.

quests.name: Measure one thing you already shipped
quests.description: Growth Experiments sits at zero despite a great deal of built work, because nothing has a recorded before and after. Take one asset already delivered — the Essy landing page, a sequence, the outreach approach — and attach real numbers to it. This is what separates Growth Diagnosis at level 3 from Growth Strategy.
quests.reward: +50–90 Growth XP; first evidence on gro.experiments
quests.proof: A before figure, an after figure, and a stated conclusion.

quests.name: Four unbroken weeks
quests.description: Consistency is named in your own memory as the recurring theme across gym, diet and business, and it is the reason Discipline and Training Consistency both sit at zero while Technique and Knowledge do not. Pick one — training is the cheapest to prove — and log four consecutive weeks.
quests.proof: Four consecutive weeks logged, with the bad weeks included rather than restarted.

quests.name: Do not build the next tool
quests.description: An inverted quest, and the hardest one here. The tree's own evidence says tool-building is your strongest skill and your most reliable avoidance mechanism — your success-plan already bans new infrastructure before a signed client. This skill tree is itself infrastructure. Use it once a week and do not extend it until Chapter One is done.
quests.reward: Protects every other quest on this list
quests.proof: Chapter One is complete and no new tool was built in the meantime.
